title: ARISE: An Adaptive Resolution-Aware Metric for Test-Time Scaling Evaluation in Large Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Zhangyue Yin、Qiushi Sun、Zhiyuan Zeng、Zhiyuan Yu、Qipeng Guo、Xuanjing Huang、Xipeng Qiu（机构：复旦大学、香港大学、南京大学、上海 AI Laboratory、上海创新研究院）
paper_type_zh: 测试时扩展评测指标研究（Findings of ACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 比较推理模型质量—成本扩展行为的读者。
one_line: ARISE evaluates test-time scaling by rewarding per-sample improvements and penalizing accuracy regressions that consume more tokens.
ARISE 以样本级正确性变化和词元成本评测测试时扩展，并惩罚越算越错的负向扩展。
why: It prevents a model from appearing efficient when it spends extra tokens to turn correct answers into errors.
inclusion_reason: It makes accuracy changes and token costs at individual scaling steps explicit in the evaluation of inference-time compute.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time scaling is often summarized by an accuracy–token curve or a slope computed from aggregate points. Such summaries can hide what happened to individual problems. A model may solve some formerly incorrect samples with extra thought while also converting previously correct samples into errors; an aggregate slope may even reward a run that used more tokens for worse results. Stochastic decoding further makes both token use and accuracy fluctuate, complicating fair comparison across models.

The paper asks how to evaluate the effectiveness of additional inference computation without treating all performance changes as equally good. It seeks a metric that follows individual samples across successive compute levels, penalizes negative scaling rather than averaging it away, and spends evaluation trials where the observed result is uncertain. The goal is a reliable quality-cost comparison, not another strategy for generating answers.

测试时扩展常被概括为准确率—词元曲线，或由聚合点计算的斜率。这类概括会掩盖单个问题发生的变化。模型可能用额外思考解出原先错误的样本，同时也把原先正确的样本变成错误；聚合斜率甚至可能奖励一个花费更多词元却得到更差结果的运行。随机解码还会让词元使用和准确率都波动，增加跨模型公平比较的难度。

论文追问如何评估额外推理计算的有效性，而不把所有性能变化都视为同样有益。它寻求一种指标，在连续计算级别上跟踪单个样本、惩罚负向扩展而不是把它平均掉，并把评估试次花在观察结果不确定的地方。目标是可靠的质量—成本比较，而不是另一种生成答案的策略。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ARISE evaluates transitions between adjacent scaling iterations for each sample. A transition from incorrect to correct receives a positive contribution weighted by the relative extra token cost; a transition from correct to incorrect receives a larger negative contribution that grows with wasted computation. Unchanged outcomes contribute nothing. The metric therefore distinguishes a useful correction from a costly regression instead of relying solely on the overall direction of a benchmark curve.

Its second component is adaptive resolution. The evaluation begins with a minimum number of trials and estimates variation in both correctness and token consumption. Samples or settings with greater observed variability receive additional trials, while stable cases do not consume the same evaluation budget. This makes measurement itself budget-aware and aims to reduce the instability caused by high-temperature, repeated reasoning runs.

ARISE 为每个样本评估相邻扩展迭代之间的转换。从错误变为正确的转换得到正贡献，其权重由相对增加的词元成本决定；从正确变为错误的转换得到更大的负贡献，且会随浪费计算增长。结果不变则不贡献。因此，该指标能区分有用的纠正与昂贵的退化，而不只依赖一条基准曲线的总体方向。

第二个组成部分是自适应分辨率。评估先以最少试次开始，并估计正确性与词元消耗的变异。观察到变异较大的样本或设定会获得更多试次，稳定情形则不会消耗同样的评估预算。这样，测量本身也具有预算意识，并试图降低高温重复推理运行造成的不稳定性。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each sample and scaling iteration, the method records binary correctness and token consumption. It computes a contribution from each adjacent pair of iterations rather than from all possible pairs. Improvements are weighted by the ratio of earlier to later tokens, while degradations receive the inverse, negative weight; this makes the penalty for using more computation to lose correctness stronger than the reward for a similarly sized improvement. The final score averages these sample-level contributions.

ARISE then uses an initial probing phase to estimate coefficients of variation for accuracy and token use. Its dynamic sampling mechanism allocates more evaluation runs when those statistics indicate unstable measurements. The paper applies this protocol to contemporary reasoning models across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks. The relevant record is a sequence of per-sample outcomes and costs at explicit compute levels, which is precisely what a scaling comparison must preserve for later audit.

对于每个样本和扩展迭代，方法记录二元正确性与词元消耗。它从每对相邻迭代计算贡献，而不是从所有可能配对计算。改进按早期词元与后期词元的比率加权，退化则得到其倒数的负权重；这使得花费更多计算却失去正确性的惩罚，强于规模相近改进的奖励。最终分数对这些样本级贡献求平均。

ARISE 随后用初始探测阶段估计准确率和词元使用的变异系数。其动态采样机制在这些统计量显示测量不稳定时分配更多评估运行。论文将该协议用于数学推理、代码生成和智能体任务上的当代推理模型。相关记录是在明确计算级别下每个样本的结果与成本序列，这正是可供后续审计的扩展比较必须保留的内容。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper evaluates contemporary reasoning models in mathematics, code generation, and agentic domains. It reports that ARISE gives a fine-grained, stable measure of scaling effectiveness and exposes substantial differences in scaling efficiency that aggregate metrics can obscure. In the reported comparisons, Claude Opus obtains the strongest ARISE characteristics across the evaluated task domains, illustrating that a model’s ordinary accuracy and its quality-cost response to more inference can be distinct properties.

The evidence supports an evaluation claim rather than a new model-capability claim. It shows why negative transitions and token instability must be visible when comparing scaling curves. A reviewer should nevertheless inspect the number of compute levels, decoding settings, task-specific correctness functions, and adaptive-sampling thresholds. The metric’s ranking can depend on those protocol choices, particularly when outcomes are subjective or when additional tokens have a cost not well approximated by generated-token count.

官方论文在数学、代码生成和智能体领域评估当代推理模型。它报告，ARISE 提供细粒度而稳定的扩展有效性度量，并揭示聚合指标可能掩盖的大幅扩展效率差异。在报告的比较中，Claude Opus 在所评估任务领域上取得最强的 ARISE 特征，说明模型的普通准确率与其面对更多推理计算时的质量—成本响应可以是不同性质。

这些证据支持的是评估主张，而不是新的模型能力主张。它说明比较扩展曲线时，必须看见负向转换与词元不稳定性。不过，审阅者仍应检查计算级别数、解码设定、任务特定正确性函数以及自适应采样阈值。指标给出的排序可能依赖这些协议选择，尤其在结果具有主观性，或额外词元成本不能被生成词元数充分近似时。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
ARISE changes the unit of a scaling evaluation from an aggregate curve point to a transition experienced by one sample. This matters because test-time computation can have asymmetric consequences: recovering a wrong answer is useful, but losing an already correct answer after spending more tokens is especially harmful. The metric encodes that asymmetry directly instead of allowing accuracy averages or slopes to erase it.

It also treats evaluation sampling as a resource-allocation problem. Rather than fixing the same number of trials for all samples and budgets, it uses observed variance to decide where more measurement resolution is needed. The contribution is therefore a coupled design for what is scored and how confidently it is measured, making the reliability of a scaling claim part of the evaluation rather than an afterthought.

ARISE 把扩展评估的单位从聚合曲线点改为单个样本经历的一次转换。这很重要，因为测试时计算可能带来不对称后果：纠正一个错误答案有用，但在花费更多词元后失去原本正确的答案尤其有害。指标直接编码这种不对称性，而不是让准确率平均值或斜率将其抹去。

它还把评估采样视为资源分配问题。方法不为所有样本和预算固定相同试次数，而是用观察到的方差决定哪里需要更多测量分辨率。因此，贡献是一套耦合设计，既规定评什么，也规定如何有把握地测量，使扩展主张的可靠性成为评估的一部分，而不是事后的补充。

title: Limitations
局限
html: ARISE relies on binary task outcomes and generated-token counts, which may not represent partial credit, execution latency, tool costs, user value, or safety risk. Its asymmetric penalties are a normative choice: another deployment may value avoiding a regression differently from recovering an error. Adaptive sampling improves reliability but still consumes evaluation budget and introduces threshold choices. The metric should therefore accompany, rather than replace, task-specific analysis and a transparent report of the decoding, budget, and correctness protocol that generated the underlying transitions.
ARISE 依赖二元任务结果和生成词元数，这些量可能无法表示部分得分、执行延迟、工具成本、用户价值或安全风险。其不对称惩罚是一种规范性选择：另一种部署可能对避免退化和纠正错误赋予不同价值。自适应采样改善可靠性，但仍消耗评估预算并引入阈值选择。因此，该指标应与任务特定分析及透明报告的解码、预算和正确性协议共同使用，而不是取代它们。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ARISE when publishing or auditing a quality-cost scaling curve. Store per-sample correctness, total generated tokens, compute level, decoding seed, and trial count instead of only reporting aggregate accuracy. Then calculate which samples improved, which regressed, and how much extra computation each transition consumed. The adaptive protocol is useful when some prompts are highly variable and others are stable, because it avoids spending identical evaluation effort everywhere. It is particularly valuable for detecting a system that looks better on average while becoming less dependable on already solved cases.
发布或审计质量—成本扩展曲线时，可使用 ARISE。应保存每个样本的正确性、总生成词元、计算级别、解码随机种子和试次数，而不只报告聚合准确率；再计算哪些样本改善、哪些退化，以及每次转换消耗了多少额外计算。当一些提示高度可变、另一些稳定时，自适应协议很有用，因为它避免在所有地方花费相同评估精力。它尤其适合发现一种平均看似更好、却在原本已解案例上变得更不可靠的系统。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: When reading the paper, audit the transition table rather than only the final ARISE value. Check that token budgets strictly increase, that samples are paired across iterations, and that a correct-to-incorrect transition is not hidden by later recovery. Reproduce the metric with fixed model outputs before enabling adaptive sampling, then vary the sampling threshold to quantify its effect on confidence and cost. For a real service, add wall-clock latency, verifier calls, and tool executions beside token counts; otherwise a favorable ARISE score may miss the actual bottleneck.
阅读论文时，应审计转换表，而不只看最终 ARISE 数值。需要检查词元预算是否严格递增、样本是否跨迭代配对，以及一次从正确变错的转换是否被后来的恢复掩盖。应先用固定模型输出复现指标，再启用自适应采样，并改变采样阈值以量化其对置信度和成本的影响。对于真实服务，还应将实际延迟、验证器调用和工具执行与词元数并列；否则一个看似有利的 ARISE 分数可能错过真正的瓶颈。
